description.narrative: Swedfund has issued a loan to Teyliom Finance directed at Bridge Bank Microfinance (BBM) for lending to micro, small and medium-sized enterprises mainly operating in Côte d'Ivoire. BBM also intends to develop specific offers to female entrepreneurs._x000D_ _x000D_ Swedfund's investment gives small and large companies access to financing to develop and in many cases grow their business. This contributes to increased financial inclusion as well as enhancing women's economic empowerment as Bridge Bank develops specific offers to women entrepreneurs and MSMEs led by women._x000D_ _x000D_ The investment contributes to private sector development in Africa, increased access to finance for companies and increased capacity and skills to address sustainability issues. The investment is expected to contribute to women's economic empowerment by supporting female leaders, workers and entrepreneurs. Furthermore, the investment is expected to contribute to jobs and other income-generating opportunities locally.
